```yaml
name: Build and Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ steps.set_tag.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - run: pip install build twine

      - run: python -m build

      - run: python -m twine upload dist/*

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/*

      - id: set_tag
        run: |
          echo "tag=$(python -c 'import importlib.metadata; print(importlib.metadata.version(\"ha-mcp\"))')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  create_draft_release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ needs.build.outputs.tag }}-dev
          name: "Dev Release ${{ needs.build.outputs.tag }}-dev"
          draft: true
          prerelease: true
          body: "Automated dev release."
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  upload_assets:
    needs: create_draft_release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist

      - uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ needs.build.outputs.tag }}-dev
          files: dist/*
          draft: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  publish_release:
    needs: upload_assets
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_publish.yml
    with:
      tag: ${{ needs.build.outputs.tag }}-dev
```
